name: textnode-maxlines
$comment: Phase 31 (v9.2.0) TextNode.maxLines axis parity fixture. Byte-parallel with chat-composer.json posture: 4 sequential steps exercise ALL FOUR wire states of TextNode.maxLines (unset / 1 / 2 / 3), each carrying a UNIQUE `expectBodyContains` tripwire that only the target branch can emit per AGENTS.md gotcha #9 class-3 lesson ('branches the fixture never runs are invisible to the byte-diff'). The unset step's marker text `TextNodeMaxLinesProbe=unset` is emitted by the buildVm arm ONLY when the state slot is empty (the wire-absent case); a mutation that stopped emitting the marker OR started emitting `"maxLines":null` when unset would fail LOUDLY — the always-on findNulls invariant (parity/run.ts) catches the second (class-2 gotcha-#8 defect: normalize scrubs `"field":null` BEFORE the diff so parity structurally can't see it; findNulls sees the raw parsed body). The 3 numbered steps assert the exact `"maxLines":N` wire literal for N∈{1,2,3} — closed-enum wire values, more diff-robust than the DOM class emission (which is browser-only). Steps run sequentially and mutate the FeatureProbeState slot cumulatively; each step's marker text uniquely identifies its state (`TextNodeMaxLinesProbe=1|2|3`) so carry-over from a prior step's marker never satisfies the current step's assertion. Byte-parallel with chat-composer.json — same $comment discipline, same class-2/class-3 defense structure. Do NOT weaken these tripwires without a plan-authored rationale — they are what stops a maxLines regression from being invisible to the diff.

steps.$comment: Branch UNSET. State slot defaults to "" → buildVm renders TextNode(value:"TextNodeMaxLinesProbe=unset") with MaxLines omitted. The positive substring proves the branch ran. The always-on findNulls invariant separately catches a `"maxLines":null` regression (class-2 gotcha-#8 defect the normalize scrubs before diff).

Branch MAXLINES=1. State slot flipped to "1"; buildVm renders TextNode(value:"TextNodeMaxLinesProbe=1", maxLines:1). BOTH assertions must pass: the marker text confirms the branch ran; the `"maxLines":1` wire literal confirms the axis emitted correctly.
Branch MAXLINES=2. Same shape as step 2; carry-over test: the prior step's `"maxLines":1` and `TextNodeMaxLinesProbe=1` MUST NOT satisfy this step's assertions (the state slot flipped).
Branch MAXLINES=3. Closes the closed-enum coverage; anything above 3 is out-of-scope per CONTEXT §deferred 'Values 4+'.
